sources.title: jev-student-4b-yizao — vincentzhou/jev-student-4b-yizao
sources.snippet: What this model is for jev-student-4b-yizao is a Hugging Face text-generation model intended for typed decisions and related decision-model workflows. The record identifies it as a 4-billion-parameter model based on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base, with Qwen3.5 text and text-generation modalities.

sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco–based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. [1][2]

sources.title: GitHub - jaredpalmer/kev: Jev-like family of decision models built on ...
sources.snippet: Small Jev-like decision models you can train and run yourself. Kev is a family of small decision models built on Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 and based on the architecture described in Jev's Architecture Unmasked. You can use the pretrained weights or train your own. The API matches TypeSafe's System One, so you can point their Python SDK at your local server.
